description: This file defines the Sugarpdf class, which extends TCPDF, and is responsible for generating PDF documents within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes configuration, class constants, and methods for PDF customization, table rendering, and output handling, tailored to the SuiteCRM module context.

classes.name: Sugarpdf
classes.description: The Sugarpdf class extends TCPDF to provide PDF generation capabilities tailored for SuiteCRM modules, including custom headers, footers, table rendering, and output configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Sugarpdf object, setting module, bean, and action context, and calling the parent TCPDF constructor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Calls preDisplay and display methods to generate the PDF content.

methods.name: displayErrors
methods.description: Outputs any accumulated errors for debugging or user notification.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Sets document information and PDF properties before rendering content.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Default implementation to add a page and display placeholder text; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Overrides the TCPDF Header method to render custom header with logo, title, and line.

methods.name: SetFont
methods.description: Overrides TCPDF's SetFont to utilize custom font directory if specified.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Outputs module, action, and bean info for debugging.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Overrides TCPDF's Cell to preprocess strings before rendering.

methods.name: Ln1
methods.description: Adds a line break with a fixed height.

methods.name: writeCellTable
methods.description: Renders a table in the PDF from a given array of cell data, with options for styling.

methods.name: writeHTMLTable
methods.description: Builds and optionally outputs an HTML table based on data array and style options.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps content in HTML tags with styling options.

methods.name: getLineHeightFromArray
methods.description: Calculates the height of a multi-line row based on content and cell widths.

methods.name: initOptionsForWriteCellTable
methods.description: Initializes options array for writeCellTable method, applying defaults and calculations.

methods.name: getNumLines
methods.description: Estimates the number of text lines needed to fit within a specified width.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Overrides TCPDF's Output to disable zlib compression when outputting to browser or download.
